digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI (+ Mgombato for pamba)

teaser.en: 'Climbing cotton': a milky-sapped liana whose pods burst into tufts of silky white floss.
teaser.sw: 'Pamba inayotambaa': mtambaa wenye utomvu mweupe ambao maganda yake hupasuka na kutoa vishungi vya pamba nyeupe laini kama hariri.
teaser.dg: 'Pamba ya kukpwera': libugu renye maziya, ambaro makakayage ganaahuka na kulavya nyuzi-nyuzi nyereru, laini dza hariri.

summary.en: Libugu pamba is a twining liana with milky latex whose pods release seeds tufted with silky white hairs. Its name, 'climbing cotton', describes both its habit and its woolly fruit.
summary.sw: Libugu pamba ni mtambaa unaojizungusha wenye utomvu mweupe, ambao maganda yake hutoa mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele nyeupe laini kama hariri. Jina lake, 'pamba inayotambaa', linaeleza namna unavyokua na matunda yake yenye sufu.
summary.dg: *Libugu pamba* ni libugu rinalodzizunguluka, renye maziya, na makakayage ganalavya tembe zenye nyere nyereru laini dza hariri. Dzinare, 'pamba ya kukpwera', rinaonyesa vira rinavyokpwera na vira matundage ganavyohalana na pamba.

about.en: Libugu pamba is a woody twining climber that bleeds white milky latex when cut. Its leaves are in opposite pairs, glossy and often heart-shaped at the base. The small flowers are dark red to purplish inside, with a ring of slender appendages in the centre. The fruits are long, paired pods that spread apart like horns. When ripe they split to release many flat seeds, each with a tuft of silky white hairs, which give the plant its name. Digo people identify it by its leaves and fruits.
about.sw: Libugu pamba ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti unaojizungusha, ambao hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa ukikatwa. Majani yake huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yanang'aa na mara nyingi yana umbo la moyo kwenye kitako. Maua madogo ni mekundu-meusi hadi zambarau ndani, yakiwa na duara la vitokeo vyembamba katikati. Matunda ni maganda marefu yaliyo kwa jozi, yanayoachana kama pembe. Yakikomaa hupasuka kutoa mbegu nyingi bapa, kila moja ikiwa na kishungi cha nywele nyeupe laini kama hariri, ambazo ndizo zilizoupa mmea jina lake. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg: *Libugu pamba* ni libugu ra mihi migumu rinalodzizunguluka, na richikatwa rinalavya maziya ga rangi nyereru. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalolana, ganang'ala, na mara nyinji photsi gana umbo ra moyo. Maruwage madide ni ga kundu sana hadi ga zambarau ndani, na kahi-kahi kuna pete ya vitu vidide vyembamba. Matundage ni makakaya mare ganayomera phairi-phairi, ganayotawanyika dza pembe. Gachiivwa ganaahuka na kulavya tembe nyinji bapa, chila mwenga na nyere nyereru laini dza hariri, ndizo zinazopha mmea dzinare. Adigo anarimanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It climbs in forest, forest edges and thicket, twining up into the trees.
where.sw: Hupanda msituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani, ukijizungusha hadi juu mitini.
where.dg: Rinakpwera tsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani, richidzizunguluka dzulu ya mihi.

uses.en: Pakia records no use for it among the Digo. In West Africa, where it is widespread, it is an important plant of traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Afrika Magharibi, ambako umeenea sana, ni mmea muhimu katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo. Afrika ya Magharibi, ambapho rinamera phatu phanji, ni mmea muhimu wa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: The name is a clear description of the plant. *-bugu* is the Digo root for a climber, and *pamba* is cotton, here referring to the woolly fruits. Pakia gives *libugu pamba* as an example of a name built from a noun and a describing word.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaeleza mmea waziwazi. *-bugu* ni shina la Kidigo la mtambaa, na *pamba* ni pamba, hapa likirejelea matunda yake yenye sufu. Pakia anatoa *libugu pamba* kama mfano wa jina lililoundwa kwa nomino na neno la kueleza.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa mmea wazi-wazi. *-bugu* ni seemu ya neno ra Chidigo inayomaanisha mmea wa kukpwera, na *pamba* ni pamba; phapha neno hiri rina mana ya matundage ganayohalana na pamba. Pakia anapha *libugu pamba* dza mfwano wa dzina rinalodzengbwa kula dzina na neno ra kuonyesa sifa.

names.en: Digo: *libugu pamba*, 'climbing cotton'. Mgombato gives *pamba* as cotton (Swahili *pamba*). Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *libugu pamba*, 'pamba inayotambaa'. Mgombato inatoa *pamba* kama pamba (Kiswahili *pamba*). Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *libugu pamba*, 'pamba ya kukpwera'. Mgombato inaandika *pamba* kukala ni *cotton* (Chiswahili *pamba*). Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, bila dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.en: Cotton, which its woolly fruits are compared to
reason.sw: Pamba, ambayo matunda yake yenye sufu yanalinganishwa nayo
reason.dg: *Pamba*, ambayo matunda ga mmea uhu ganahalana nayo

reason.en: Kapok, another plant with woolly fruits
reason.sw: Msufi, mmea mwingine wenye matunda ya sufu
reason.dg: *Msufi*, mmea wanjina wenye matunda genye pamba

reason.en: Another climber of the milkweed group
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wa kundi la milkweed
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa kukpwera wa kundi ra *milkweed*

reason.en: Chibugu, another name built on the root bugu, 'climber'
reason.sw: Chibugu, jina jingine lililojengwa juu ya shina bugu, 'mtambaa'
reason.dg: *Chibugu*, dzina ranjina rinalodzengbwa kula *bugu*, 'mmea wa kukpwera'
